During the latest visit on March 25, 2026, the patient reported no new symptoms and exhibited stable vital signs. His blood pressure was recorded at 121/78, and his weight was 141 pounds. These values indicate that the patient's heart failure is currently under control.

The patient's medical management includes spironolactone 25 mg, which has been effective in maintaining his heart failure in a controlled state. The patient has been compliant with his medication regimen and has not reported any adverse effects from the treatment.
